sovereign_country.strategic_role: 制造业产业链转移第一站、保税加工（EPE）设立首选

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Administration of Employee Share Incentive Plans (ESOP Trusts)

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (Viet Nam)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP)
Viet Nam–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (VJEPA) including Investment Chapter
Agreement between the Government of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam and the Government of the Republic of Korea on the Promotion and Protection of Investments
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam on the Promotion and Protection of Investments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15; Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP on anti-money laundering and combating terrorist financing; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Civil Code No. 91/2015/QH13. Beneficial ownership and UBO identification obligations are set out in Articles 3 and 9 of Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP, using the 25% ownership/control threshold.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of founder/shareholder passport or national identification document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of jurisdiction of nationality / passport office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified by a Vietnamese Notary Public against the original; if the original is in a non-Hague country, Vietnamese consular legalization is required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or Business Registration Certificate of the corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if originating country is a member of the Apostille Convention; otherwise Vietnamese consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association or constitutive documents of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry / notary public in jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the Vietnamese incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized in the country of execution, then Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds for initial share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized or certified by the issuing bank and legalized/apostilled as required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of audited financial statements (if the investor is a corporate entity and financial capacity evidence is required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular legalization, with certified Vietnamese translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based KYC/AML screening of all direct and beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Vietnamese Ministry of Public Security designated terrorist list, and a domestic PEP database. PEPs, family members, and close associates must receive enhanced due diligence under Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP and Law No. 14/2022/QH15. Continuous monitoring of politically exposed persons and adverse media is required for the ESOP trust administrator and its beneficiaries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp – National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory Vietnamese enterprise name must be capable of being read in Vietnamese and must include the enterprise type followed by a proper name. Vietnamese alphabet letters, digits, and the letters F, J, Z, and W may be used only where legally permissible. A foreign-language name may be registered as a supplementary name, and any transliteration must be faithful, phonetically consistent, and not confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical to or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise already registered in the National Business Registration Database
Names containing 'Bank', 'Securities', 'Insurance', 'Audit', 'Mutual Fund', or other licensed financial services terminology without the relevant regulatory license
Names using ministries, state agencies, municipal bodies, political organizations, or mass organizations without prior written approval
Names contrary to national sovereignty, national security, public order, or social ethics
Improper use of 'Viet Nam', 'Socialist Republic of Viet Nam', or state symbols in a manner implying government affiliation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The Department of Planning and Investment issues a written refusal or request for correction via the National Business Registration Portal. The applicant may amend and resubmit the dossier without a new fee if the requested correction is made within the statutory deadline. Upon a final rejection, the applicant may file a complaint with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days, and may thereafter initiate an administrative action before the Provincial Administrative Court. No standalone name reservation extension exists; after 30 days from initial provisional clearance without successful incorporation, a fresh application and name clearance are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permitted as the sole registered office. The LLC must maintain a physical address in Viet Nam under a lawful right to use, evidenced by a lease contract, certificate of land use rights, or notarized written permission of the property owner. A virtual-office service may be used only as an additional mailing address and must not serve as the statutory head office for receipt of official legal notices and tax authority correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate. Estimated 5–10% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Department of Planning and Investment, tax authorities, or an inter-agency inspection team. The risk increases materially if the registered address shows only a mail-office profile, lacks signage, or the company cannot produce documents evidencing lawful use of the premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise name clearance and administrative filing fee on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee applied by the National Business Registration System

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment / Investment Registration Agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee schedule applicable to investment registration filings

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular/apostille legalization of investor passports, corporate documents, powers of attorney, and bank reference letters
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vietnamese Notary Public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and/or Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate in the investor's jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial and consular fee schedule plus prevailing market courier and translation charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese and English translations of incorporation and UBO-related documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed translation service provider / notary-certified translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for certified legal translations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC/AML, UBO piercing, PEP, OFAC, UN, and Vietnamese sanctions database screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance database provider / law firm screening operations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial per-screen fee benchmark plus law firm review costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due diligence opinion, corporate structure memorandum, and drafting of incorporation dossier for the ESOP trust administrator LLC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for foreign-invested LLC pre-incorporation legal advisory services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address pre-incorporation arrangement and lease documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Property owner / commercial registered-office service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for head-office lease deposit and legal documentation for one quarter

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal engravature (con dấu công ty) and related notarized specimen records
Courier, records search, bank account preparatory documentation, and contingency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Courier services, information providers, and logistics vendors

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 22-29, 47-60, 75-83 on LLC registration, capital contribution, corporate governance and legal representative); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 23-24, 38 on investment registration for foreign investors and issuance of Investment Registration Certificate); Decree 01/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Enterprises and Enterprise Registration; Decree 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city where the registered head office is located; online submission via the National Business Registration Portal at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1 issued under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP) accompanied by the Company Charter and List of Members; the Investment Registration Certificate must first be obtained for a foreign-invested LLC.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an ordinary LLC administering an internal ESOP trust under ISIC 6430. Charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days from issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate pursuant to Article 75 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. There is no escrow or blocked-account requirement at the incorporation stage; after incorporation, foreign capital contributions must be remitted through a Foreign Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened with a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST MEMBERS'/GENERAL MEETING OF VN LLC (THE COMPANY) ADOPTED ON [DATE]. WHEREAS: (i) The Company is proposed to be incorporated as a foreign-invested limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises 2020; (ii) the charter capital subscription and governance structure have been approved in the draft Company Charter; (iii) the registered office has been identified. NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED: 1. SUBSCRIPTION – The initial charter capital of VND [AMOUNT] is hereby subscribed by the member(s) in accordance with the Company Charter; contributions shall be paid in full within ninety (90) days after issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE – The registered office and legal address of the Company is adopted as [FULL ADDRESS], Vietnam, and the Company Secretary is instructed to file the address with the Business Registration Office. 3. OFFICERS – The following appointments are made effective immediately: [NAME] as General Director/Chief Executive Officer and legal representative; [NAME] as Chief Financial Officer; [NAME] as Compliance Officer responsible for ESOP trust administration, AML/CFT screening and statutory corporate records. 4. AUTHORIZATION – The General Director, acting jointly with the Company Secretary or as required by the Charter, is authorized to execute and submit all enterprise and investment registration filings, to open the foreign investment capital account, to procure the company seal, to execute tax registration forms, and to complete all ancillary statutory formalities on behalf of the Company. 5. EFFECTIVE DATE – This resolution is effective immediately and shall be retained in the statutory minute book and corporate records of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, notarization, and legalization of constituent documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vietnamese consular legalization and notary offices; corporate registry pre-screening via DPI counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare all investor and legal-person documents in Vietnam and abroad. Authenticate passports or corporate registration certificates, obtain Vietnamese consular legalization for foreign-origin documents, have Vietnamese translations notarized, and consolidate a fully executed investment project proposal and draft Company Charter. Submit a pre-screening pack to Vietnamese counsel for conformity checks against Law on Investment 61/2020/QH14 and Decree 31/2021/ND-CP.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of the foreign investor's passport or corporate registration certificate
Consular legalization of foreign corporate documents, where applicable
Certified Vietnamese translation of foreign constituent documents
Power of attorney appointing the Vietnamese authorized representative, duly executed and legalized
Draft Company Charter and investment project proposal
Financial capacity statement or bank balance certificate of the investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If documents are queried for authenticity or incomplete legalization, cure by re-submitting corrected notarized/certified copies and applying for supplementary consular legalization; there is no formal registry appeal at this preparatory stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of investment registration application for a foreign-invested LLC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) – Investment Registration Division or the National Investment Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an application for an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) using the forms prescribed under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP. Clearly state the project objective as administration and management of employee share incentive plans and ESOP trust services under ISIC 6430. Attach the legalized investor dossier, the proposal, the financial capacity proof, and the draft charter of the LLC. The DPI either issues the IRC or replies in writing with a request for supplementation.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration
Investment project proposal covering the ESOP trust services
Valid passport/corporate registration of the investor
Investor financial capability documents (audited financial statements or bank confirmation)
Draft Company Charter
Power of attorney for the project contact/authorized representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Under Article 38 of the Law on Investment 2020, the DPI may require supplementary documents within 10 working days. The investor must respond within 10 working days; if the DPI fails to decide, the investor may lodge a complaint with the provincial People's Committee or initiate an administrative lawsuit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the Investment Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), Investment Registration Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Monitor the application status on the National Investment Portal. Upon approval, receive the hard-copy IRC at the DPI one-stop service counter or through postal delivery. Verify that the IRC accurately records the legal capital, the ESOP trust scope (ISIC 6430), the head office address, and the foreign investor's identity details before proceeding to enterprise registration.
required_dossiers: Submitted investment registration application and all attachments
Receipt or tracking number for the application dossier
Written approval/document from DPI if any name or business line clarification was issued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the IRC is not issued within the statutory period or is refused, obtain the written refusal letter and lodge an appeal to the provincial People's Committee under Article 79 of the Law on Investment 2020, or file for administrative judicial review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise registration application and issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office under the provincial DPI via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) or the one-stop service counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the IRC, prepare and submit the Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1) together with the Charter as approved by the investor, the List of Members, and supporting legal documents. The legal representative signs the application. Pay the statutory business registration fee electronically or at the counter. The registry issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days of receiving a complete valid dossier.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form I-1)
Approved Company Charter
List of Members (members/equity holders and their subscribed capital)
Certified copies of identity documents of the authorized representative and each member
Valid Investment Registration Certificate
Authorization document for the individual submitting the dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a notice requiring correction, resubmit an amended dossier within 10 working days. If the registry refuses registration, the applicant may appeal to the Director of the DPI and subsequently to the Ministry of Planning and Investment or an administrative court in accordance with the Law on Enterprises 2020 and the Law on Administrative Procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation formalities: seal, bank account, tax registration, and social insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial tax department (General Department of Taxation), licensed commercial banks on the DICA list, notary/public service portals, and Vietnam Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: With the Enterprise Registration Certificate, open the foreign investment direct account at a licensed bank in Vietnam, notify the seal specimen to the Business Registration Office (if a company seal is adopted), complete tax registration using Form 01-DK-TCT on the national tax portal (eTax), register electronic invoices, and register for social insurance with the local Vietnam Social Security agency. Appoint the company legal representative and maintain statutory records of members and contributions.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Company Charter and List of Members
First board/members' resolution appointing officers
Company seal specimen notice form
Bank account opening application and banking forms
Tax registration declaration (Form 01-DK-TCT)
Social insurance and labor book/employment declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration or seal notification is delayed or queried, resubmit corrected forms online, provide supporting ERC documents, and request urgent review from the district tax officer; administrative appeals may be made to the provincial tax department under the Tax Administration Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire safety, workplace clearance, and physical office compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Police Department (CSCD) under the provincial Police Department; local Department of Labour and Social Affairs for occupational safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a fire prevention and fighting dossier for the office premises, including floor plans, fire extinguisher layout, exit routes, and proof of fire safety equipment. Ensure the physical office meets minimum workplace conditions under the Labor Code 2019. Obtain the fire safety acceptance certificate or written approval, and retain workplace inspection files for labor inspectors. For an ESOP/trust administration office there is no industrial production, so no environmental discharge permit is required unless significant modifications are made to the building.
required_dossiers: Fire prevention and fighting design application form
Floor plan and location map of the registered office
Fire equipment installation plan and maintenance contract
Certificate of completion of fire safety training for responsible personnel
Workplace environment and health and safety policy documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If fire safety approval is refused, correct the listed structural or equipment defects, document remedial measures, and resubmit to the Fire Police Department; refusal may be appealed under the Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the ESOP trust administration activity under ISIC 6430 is an office-based fiduciary administration and does not constitute industrial production or a manufacturing activity requiring a separate industrial license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable for an internal employee incentive trust. No operating license is required for the administration of an ESOP trust as a foreign-invested LLC under Vietnamese law; however, if the entity were to act as a public third-party trust/fiduciary manager or administer securities portfolios for third parties, a license from the State Securities Commission would be necessary.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) for EIA policy guidance; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for any discharge registrations applicable to office premises
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the ESOP trust administration activity is a non-industrial office use and is not listed in Annexes II and IV of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP as a project requiring environmental impact assessment registration or a full EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic sanitary wastewater from the office, if any, must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT before entering the municipal sewer system. Office solid waste must be managed and handed over to licensed collection units under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP, and any hazardous waste, if generated in administrative quantities, must be managed under QCVN 50:2013/BTNMT. There are no manufacturing VOC, combustion stack, or industrial wastewater emission limits applicable to this activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The registered office must obtain a fire prevention and fighting clearance or acceptance certificate under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP before operation. Structural load inspection is not required unless the entity alters load-bearing elements of the building. Occupational safety clearance includes compliance with workplace conditions under the Labor Code 2019, provision of employee risk assessments, and registration of any hazardous working conditions, though ordinary administrative ESOP administration duties will generally fall below the threshold for mandatory occupational hazard registration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT / Tổng cục Thuế), Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; primary taxpayer portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; national e-invoice portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; Local Tax Departments (Cục Thuế) of provinces/centrally affiliated cities serve as the operational registration and audit offices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company obtains, through the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) one-stop service, an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC). The 10-digit enterprise code recorded on the ERC simultaneously constitutes the statutory Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, MST) under Law on Enterprise Registration (2019) and Law on Tax Administration (38/2019/QH14). The LLC must (i) complete supplementary tax registration for VAT, personal income tax, payroll withholding and any dependent branch codes via the GDT e-portal within 30 days of ERC issuance; (ii) procure a licensed digital certificate (chữ ký số) for the legal representative and the enterprise; (iii) register for the mandatory e-invoice scheme on the GDT portal; and (iv) open a Vietnamese foreign-currency and VND settlement bank account for tax payment and export remittance collection. No separate application for the tax code is required after ERC issuance; the tax code becomes legally active upon DPI issuance, and a tax registration certificate is auto-generated in the e-tax system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity election is recognized under Vietnamese law for a domestic LLC; corporate income tax at the entity level is compulsory. The only available elections concern tax mechanics rather than entity classification: (i) VAT method election between the credit (input-deduction) method and the direct percentage method on gross revenue, available to taxpayers with annual revenue below VND 1 billion; (ii) for a foreign contractor without a permanent establishment, the election between deemed Foreign Contractor Tax collection at source (fixed VAT/CIT rates) versus self-assessment where the contractor maintains compliant accounts and obtains registration; (iii) export processing enterprise (EPE) status election, which yields customs VAT deferral/exemption privileges but does not create a separate tax person; and (iv) transfer pricing methodological elections (including advance pricing agreement applications) under Circular 05/2025/TT-BTC, which do not affect entity classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Organizations and business households with annual revenue from taxable production or trading of goods and services of VND 1 billion (approx. US$40,000) or more are mandatorily registered for VAT under the credit method; taxpayers below this threshold may voluntarily register or apply the direct method on revenue. Foreign contractors and foreign organizations deriving Vietnamese-source revenue are subject to deemed VAT withholding (Foreign Contractor Tax) from the first Vietnamese dong of gross turnover, irrespective of the VND 1 billion threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing is mandatory for all Vietnamese enterprises from 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Businesses must issue validated e-invoices using certified software in standardized XML format, sign them with a legally recognized digital certificate, and transmit the invoice data to the GDT e-invoice portal within 24 hours of issuance through secured REST/SOAP web-service APIs or the GDT-hosted T-WEB interface. The majority of taxpayers self-generate 'e-invoices without tax-authority code'; higher-risk taxpayers and specific transaction types (e.g., those involving tax refund applications) are directed by GDT to use 'e-invoices with tax-authority code', whereby the authority issues a digital fiscal code for each invoice before issuance. Periodic (monthly) aggregate declaration of e-invoice data is prohibited for refund purposes. No physical fiscal stamping or hardware fiscalization module exists; the GDT performs digital cross-clearance by reconciling e-invoice records against customs, banking, and monthly VAT return (GTGT01) data in real time.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods and services exported from Viet Nam, including offshore services supplied to foreign organizations or individuals and consumed wholly outside Vietnamese territory, are eligible for the 0% VAT rate (Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC, Article 9). Conditions: (i) a valid export contract with a non-resident customer (or a contract directly with a foreign outsourcer for processing/services); (ii) for goods, presentation of a customs export declaration or an EPE delivery note; (iii) a commercial invoice and, for services, a service completion certificate and documentary evidence of actual consumption abroad; (iv) payment received in freely convertible foreign currency through a licensed Vietnamese bank (or offset/clearing arrangement specifically approved by the State Bank of Viet Nam); and (v) the service is not one statutorily excluded from zero-rating (e.g., labor supply into Viet Nam, services attached to Vietnamese real estate, reinsurance/insurance of Vietnamese assets, international transport of passengers/transit). For an ESOP administration LLC, administrative, custodial and trustee-support services rendered to an overseas corporate trustee, sponsor or employee benefit plan, where the services are performed for and consumed outside Viet Nam and no onshore beneficiary exercise occurs, constitute zero-rated export services; the taxpayer must maintain a precise service-delivery log demonstrating the offshore place of consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan) as electronically cleared, or EPE in-country delivery note for deemed exports
Bill of Lading (sea freight) or Air Waybill (air freight) evidencing actual physical departure from Vietnamese territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank foreign-currency collection confirmation (chứng từ thanh toán qua ngân hàng) proving proceeds credited from abroad
Export services contract (for ESOP administration) specifying foreign customer, scope, place of performance, and offshore consumption
Commercial invoice and service completion/acceptance certificate signed by the foreign recipient
Certification of actual use/utilization of the service abroad, together with the foreign customer's tax invoice or equivalent third-party evidence
Packing list (for physical goods) and certificate of origin if a preferential duty rate claim is made
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT subjects export VAT refunds to automated pre-refund and post-refund risk screening: e-invoice output, customs exit data, banking FX receipts, and service-export substantiation are reconcilable in the TMS analytics layer. Where documents are missing or inconsistent, the refund is suspended under anticipatory control, and a full documentary audit may be initiated. Any zero-rating or refund found to be unsupported or fraudulent is subject to retrospective clawback: the VAT officer issues an additional assessment recovering the refunded amount with late-payment interest charged at 0.03% per day from the original refund date, plus an administrative evasion penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount (Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14, Article 141; Decree 125/2020/ND-CP). Criminal exposure arises under Penal Code Article 200 (tax evasion) for organized or repeated schemes, with fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment up to 7 years; forged export invoices, fake customs declarations, or false service contracts additionally expose responsible managers/beneficial owners to penalties for smuggling (Article 188), producing counterfeit documents (Article 201), and property-related fraud (Article 341), and the enterprise may be disqualified from the expedited refund channel for up to 5 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) – Supervision Department and Foreign Exchange Control Department; Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) for investment registration; General Department of Taxation (GDT) for tax-related FX filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam operates a managed floating exchange rate regime. Current account transactions are generally convertible for trade and service-related payments, subject to underlying documentation and SBV reporting. Capital account transactions require registration, licensing, or prior approval. Profit remittances to foreign investors are permitted after the completion of audited financial statements, tax finalization, satisfaction of statutory reserve requirements, and issuance of a profit remittance approval by the licensing authority. All remittances must be routed through a licensed domestic commercial bank with a valid Foreign Investment Account (FIA).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be repatriated to Vietnam through an authorized bank within 180 days of the date of export shipment completion, unless an extension is approved by the SBV. Mandatory surrender/conversion ratios are determined by the SBV on a case-by-case basis; however, certain export receipts may be subject to a statistically targeted conversion requirement to maintain national foreign exchange equilibrium. For the ESOP trust entity, which is not primarily engaged in export trade, this requirement applies only to incidental export-related receipts and is not the core operational burden.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietcombank (Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam)
BIDV (Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam)
VietinBank (Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade)
Techcombank (Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital EMI licenses do not confer a legal passport to provide banking or payment services in Vietnam. A foreign fintech may only act as an ancillary technology provider and must route all transactions through an SBV-licensed intermediary payment service. Capital contributions and profit repatriation must be executed through a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank and properly designated foreign investment accounts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical or in-person appearance of a corporate representative is generally required for corporate account opening. Remote opening is not permitted for the initial signatory or ultimate beneficial owner without an existing relationship; a notarized power of attorney may allow a locally appointed representative to appear. Ultimate beneficial owners identified during AML due diligence may need to attend a face-to-face interview or video call acceptable to the bank's compliance team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore holding parent or trust-like structure with non-transparent ultimate beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organizational tree showing direct ownership; trust deed and ESOP trust rules; certified copies of passport and proof of residential address for all natural-person UBOs; source of wealth and source of funds statements; audited financial statements of the trust and contributing parent company; legal opinion on the trust's validity and non-profit nature.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming capital remittance without a clearly linked purpose code or investment registration certificate
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC); Economic Organization Registration Certificate (EORC/ERC); SBV Foreign Investment Account (FIA) registration confirmation; signed share subscription or capital contribution agreement; board resolution approving capital drawdown; bank remittance instruction referencing the IRC number and correct purpose code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outgoing disbursements to offshore employee-beneficiaries or trustees triggering payroll or dividend red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ESOP plan document; award agreements and vesting schedules; payroll ledger; tax filings with GDT showing personal income tax compliance; legal memorandum confirming that the trust is administrative in nature and does not conduct licensed financial services; underlying invoice or settlement statement for each disbursement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Director or shareholder appearing on sanctions or PEP lists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening report from each bank's compliance screening tool; proof of identity documents; explanation of business rationale for any PEP status; approvals per internal escalation policy; enhanced due diligence questionnaire signed by the ultimate beneficial owner.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound investment capital must be routed through a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank into a Foreign Investment Account (FIA) established under the foreign-invested LLC. All remittances must use SWIFT MT103 and require an acceptable purpose code. The bank will verify the IRC, the capital contribution schedule in the investment registration dossier, and the foreign investor's identity. Funds received must be recorded in the FIA before conversion to Vietnamese Dong or transfer to the operational account. For the ESOP trust, any contribution from the parent company must be documented as a capital contribution through proper corporate resolutions and notified to MPI/DPI, and tax registration filings must be updated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for ESOP trust administration, employee settlements, or trade-related expenses must use cleared rails: SWIFT MT103 for direct transfers; MT202 for cover payments; and MT700 for documentary commercial letters of credit. All outbound remittances require underlying contracts, invoices, tax invoices, and SBV-licensed bank approval. Payments must be made in designated foreign currencies through a foreign currency account; VND settlement for cross-border trade is generally not permitted. For dividend or profit remittances, an SBV-approved profit remittance procedure must be completed with GDT-certified audited financial statements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards with licensed Vietnamese banks (subject to SBV tenor and underlying exposure rules)
FX Swaps (USD/VND, CNY/VND) for liquidity management with licensed banks
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (for long-term foreign currency loans with SBV approval)
NDFs only if expressly authorized by the SBV for non-convertible currency hedges; onshore USD/VND NDFs are generally not permitted
Foreign exchange options or structured hedges only where explicitly approved by the SBV and tied to real trade or investment exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Taxation and Department of Planning and Investment (via National Business Registration Portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year end; calendar-year filers by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine for late filing typically up to VND 10,000,000 (approx. USD 420); continuing failure may trigger tax assessment, business registration revocation procedures and removal of active status on the national business registration database.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 90th day after fiscal year end; calendar-year filers by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on outstanding tax; administrative fines for late filing up to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 1,050); prolonged non-compliance leads to coercive tax enforcement, bank account freezes and administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business License Tax Annual Declaration and Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 30 January; newly established entities within 30 days from Enterprise Registration Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late declaration and late payment penalties up to VND 20,000,000 (approx. USD 840), daily late-payment interest of 0.03%, and administrative enforcement against business registration; continuing failure may contribute to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Information Report to the Department of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment via National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 30 April following the reporting year (calendar-year basis)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines for failure to report or for late reporting under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-compliance may cause the enterprise to be treated as inactive and administratively revoked.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all foreign-invested enterprises, including LLC/ESOP-trust vehicles, regardless of size or revenue; audit also compulsory for public-interest entities and any enterprise expressly designated by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and the Enterprise Accounting Regime (Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC); IFRS may be applied where the domestic law and Ministry of Finance approval allow.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a separate annual UBO confirmation return for standard LLCs. For every shareholding transfer, the ESOP-trust LLC must record the transfer in the Register of Members, update the audited capital-contribution schedule, notify the Department of Planning and Investment within 10 days of any member change, and refresh AML/KYC beneficial-ownership records held with the compliance agent and banking counterparties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Accounting Ledgers and Annual Financial Statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory holiday is conferred on ISIC 6430 ESOP trust administration. Standard CIT is 20%. General preferential regimes under Law 14/2008/QH12, as amended, provide a 10% rate for up to 15 years, a 4-year CIT exemption and a 50% reduction for up to 9 years, for qualifying high-tech, large-scale and economic-zone projects; software/technology businesses may qualify for 10% for up to 15 years with exemption/reduction windows.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 03/TNDN (CIT Finalization Return) prescribed in Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC; e-filed through the General Department of Taxation portal (etax.gdt.gov.vn) or the taxpayer's Tax e-Filing account, with audited financial statements attached for foreign-invested LLCs.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year enterprise, no later than 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, tax identification number (MST), registered address, and managing tax office of the VN LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners have no duty to file this return; the LLC files under its own MST and must state its Vietnamese registered details accurately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from ESOP administration services, payroll administration fees, and trust structure services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only the LLC's service income; trust assets and pass-through plan contributions are not revenue of the LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses connected with revenue that are supported by invoices and vouchers; non-deductible statutory items must be added back.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Service fees paid to non-resident service providers are deductible only where foreign contractor tax has been declared and withheld.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest income, dividends, and gains from equity transfers of ESOP shares held by the trust.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The LLC reports its own gains; capital gains on non-resident equity transfers are separately taxed in the hands of the non-resident transferor.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: B4-B8 - Taxable income and loss carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total business income reduced by tax-exempt income and tax losses carried forward, subject to the 5-year loss carryforward limit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward is calculated at the LLC level only; non-resident beneficiaries cannot utilise Vietnamese tax losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate (20%), CIT payable, quarterly advances already paid, and balance due or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No withholding is applied to the LLC's own CIT; profit distributions to shareholders are subject to dividend WHT procedures outside this form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of all intercompany transactions, pricing methods, and comparables used by the LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete the annex even where no formal TP dossier is required; non-resident related parties must supply supporting arm's-length evidence on request.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is subject to administrative fines from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; failure to file for more than 90 days after the statutory deadline triggers a deemed tax assessment and enforced collection. Any tax underpayment attracts daily late-payment interest of 0.03% per day under Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14, Article 59.
